title: Revenge of TypeScripter
description: In a world where JavaScript reigns supreme, meet Alex, a TypeScript enthusiast who just cant seem to let go of his strong opinions about types, interfaces, and generics. Frustrated by the lack of TypeScript adoption in the wild and tired of seeing “any” everywhere, Alex decides its time to take matters into his own hands.
author: Anton Karlsson

reviews.review_text: The lack of JavaScript made me angry, otherwise a brilliant story
